title: Execute Frontend Merge + Donor Capability Harvest
brief: Selectively merge only the donor manufacturing/product surfaces that close real canonical gaps in mcp-server/web, publish a donor capability harvest ledger for every reviewed surface outside the canonical app, generate the mounted/dormant route inventory plus page-level mount/remap/waive proof for surviving backend dependencies, and leave one buildable canonical target with explicit survivor or unchanged-target-waiver evidence.
intent: All surviving frontend pages, components, hooks, contexts, and API modules that materially improve the canonical app live in the chosen target with no donor-shell fork remaining; if no selective merge is needed, publish an explicit unchanged-target waiver that APPW-MS8 can safely close against.

non_goals: Do not revive the donor shell wholesale.
Do not preserve a second active frontend target after FMERGE-MS1 closes.
Do not union-copy donor shell, UI kit, API wrappers, or hooks into the canonical app.

required_artifacts: generated route inventory with mounted vs dormant canonical routes
surviving donor page list with per-page disposition
waived donor page list with reasons
donor capability harvest ledger covering page, component, context, and workflow surfaces outside the canonical app
mount/remap/waive ledger for each backend route dependency of every surviving donor page
surviving donor frontend contracts remapped onto canonical typed clients/providers or explicitly waived
explicit code-change merge result or unchanged-target waiver
merge_output_contract.appw_handoff_requirement: FMERGE-MS1 closeout must declare the exact APPW manifest regeneration scope so APPW-MS8 does not rediscover donor survivors, route dependencies, or waived capabilities.

units.title: Selective Donor Page + Capability Review
units.description: Review donor machine/product/customer/employee/quote pages and decide survivor vs waive for each candidate surface before code moves land in the canonical frontend.
deliverables: waived donor page list with reasons

units.title: Publish Donor Capability Harvest Ledger
units.description: Publish the donor capability harvest ledger covering page, component, context, workflow, and contract surfaces outside the canonical app with disposition {mount|remap|waive} and proof.

units.title: Copy Claude-Unique Components
units.description: Bring over only the donor component groups needed by surviving machine/workspace, WEDM, SFC, employee, customer, or quote surfaces. Do not bulk-copy donor UI/layout systems.

units.title: Generate Route Inventory + Backend Consumer Audit
units.description: Generate a mounted/dormant route inventory by diffing mcp-server/src/routes/*.ts against registerRoutes(), then map donor frontend consumers onto those routes using generated route inventory and auto_wiring_analyze evidence rather than assumed route_health_audit output.

units.title: Publish Survivor Route Ledger
units.description: For every surviving donor surface, publish page -> backend route(s) -> canonical client mapping -> disposition {mount|remap|waive} -> proof before downstream APPW closeout.

units.title: Merge Hooks Contexts and Utils
units.description: Converge only the hooks, contexts, utilities, and canonical typed-client mappings required by the surviving surfaces. Do not union-copy donor api/ or hooks/ trees wholesale.

units.title: Build and Fix the Merged App
units.description: Run prism_dev:build, prism_dev:test_smoke, auto_wiring_analyze, and the generated route inventory/survivor ledger proof, then publish either survivor proof or an unchanged-target waiver for downstream APPW closeout.

required_artifacts: generated route inventory with mounted vs dormant canonical routes
surviving donor page list with per-page disposition
waived donor page list with reasons
donor capability harvest ledger covering page, component, context, and workflow surfaces outside the canonical app
mount/remap/waive ledger for each backend route dependency of every surviving donor page
surviving donor frontend contracts remapped onto canonical typed clients/providers or explicitly waived
explicit code-change merge result or unchanged-target waiver
merge_output_contract.appw_handoff_requirement: FMERGE-MS1 closeout must declare the exact APPW manifest regeneration scope so APPW-MS8 does not rediscover donor survivors, route dependencies, or waived capabilities.

highlights: Added donor capability harvest coverage for WEDM, SFC, employee, customer, and quote surfaces outside the canonical app.
Removed route_health_audit overclaim from merge execution surfaces.
Made APPW closeout explicitly dependent on donor harvest ledger plus mount/remap/waive proof.
